verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a public REST API for automating workflows. Every endpoint can be browsed and tested in interactive docs, backed by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec generated from the API code. The docs also cover Bearer/OAuth 2.0 and personal-access-token authentication, plus semantic versioning and deprecation guidance for v4. Partner integrations such as Make, which can call any GitLab endpoint, further show the API in active use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (all evidence is vendor or partner-directory material).
